subject.title: [Feature]: Proposal: Restructure VISION.md as a decision framework for humans and AI PR review

question: Should OpenClaw make VISION.md a thesis-led human/AI PR decision framework, or keep AI-auditor criteria in a separate review-policy surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing thesis wording and where automated-review criteria belong is a maintainer product/docs policy decision.

options.title: Narrow framework in VISION.md
options.body: Accept the direction but keep VISION.md concise: add a maintainer-approved thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed guardrails, then align contribution surfaces only where criteria change.

options.title: Split auditor policy out
options.body: Keep VISION.md as product principles and put detailed AI-auditor criteria in a dedicated review-policy document linked from contributor guidance.

options.title: Decline the rewrite
options.body: Leave VISION.md as a lighter roadmap guardrail and close the request if maintainers do not want it to become a review decision contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow framework in VISION.md
recommendation.body: Accept the direction but keep VISION.md concise: add a maintainer-approved thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed guardrails, then align contribution surfaces only where criteria change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is listed as project BDFL, introduced VISION.md, and already engaged with this issue's product/docs review context.
